description: Design rails for tasteroll. These are HARD CONSTRAINTS that never change — the floor beneath every roll. The actual options on each dimension are generated fresh from context at roll time; this file defines what dimensions exist and what values are always valid or invalid.

dimensions._description: Each dimension is a die. The FACES are generated fresh by the AI from audit + intake context. These entries define what dimensions exist, not what the options are.

rails._description: Hard bounds. Any roll that violates these fails the gate. These are non-negotiable regardless of seed.

audit_scope._description: What the audit phase scans for. Findings here are MANDATORY fixes — resolved before Chance runs, seed-independent.
audit_scope.contrast: Body text < 4.5:1 or UI < 3:1 on actual rendered surfaces
audit_scope.spacing: No spacing scale — arbitrary margins/padding with no token system
audit_scope.tells: Named AI slop patterns present (purple gradient, centered hero, 3 equal cards, pill buttons, glassmorphism)
audit_scope.accessibility: Missing alt text, unlabeled controls, broken heading order, viewport zoom lock
audit_scope.structure: Missing main landmark, no skip link, no focus-visible treatment

audit_non_scope._description: What the audit does NOT fix — these get flagged and handed off, not resolved by tasteroll.
audit_non_scope.copy: Bad writing, generic prose, ChatGPT accent — hand to humanize-copy
audit_non_scope.content_ia: Missing sections, bad information architecture — flag for product decision
audit_non_scope.functionality: Broken features, missing routes — flag for engineering

intake_questions._description: The 3-question mini-interview, used when inference from conversation/repo is insufficient.

q3.text: One word for how it should feel?

compatibility_rules._description: Constraints between dimensions to prevent incoherent rolls. The generation step must respect these.
compatibility_rules.density_rhythm: compact pairs with metronomic; airy pairs with syncopated or asymmetrical; standard is universal
compatibility_rules.aesthetic_motion: brutalist and operational pair with restrained or none; maximalist and humanist tolerate kinetic
compatibility_rules.color_mode_accent: in dark mode, accent lightness floor is 0.60 OKLCH; in light mode, ceiling is 0.72
